response:
{
  "plan": [
    "Identificar las adjudicaciones por provincia.",
    "Calcular el monto total adjudicado por provincia.",
    "Determinar la entidad contratante con el mayor monto adjudicado en cada provincia."
  ],
  "action": "final_sql",
  "sql": "WITH province_awards AS (
  SELECT 
    t.buyer_id,
    b.province,
    SUM(a.amount_usd) AS total_awarded_usd
  FROM 
    awards a
    JOIN tenders t ON a.tender_id = t.tender_id
    JOIN buyers b ON t.buyer_id = b.buyer_id
  GROUP BY 
    t.buyer_id, b.province
),
ranked_provinces AS (
  SELECT
    buyer_id,
    province,
    total_awarded_usd,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY province ORDER BY total_awarded_usd DESC) AS rank
  FROM
    province_awards
)
SELECT
  b.buyer_name,
  r.province,
  r.total_awarded_usd
FROM
  ranked_provinces r
  JOIN buyers b ON r.buyer_id = b.buyer_id
WHERE
  r.rank = 1
ORDER BY
  r.province;"
}
